RaggieSoft Studio • Windows 11 x64 & ARM64 Developer Tooling

One Studio Umbrella for Packaging, Launchers & Interactive Showcases

RaggieSoft Studio (raggiesoftstudio.com) is our dedicated home for developer, DevOps, and digital-distribution authoring tools. Every tool in the RaggieSoft Studio lineup shares the same non-negotiable engineering DNA: diff-friendly plain-text project files, 100% WCAG 2.2 AA keyboard, screen-reader & Dark/High-Contrast accessibility, native x64 & ARM64 execution, zero telemetry, and 100% white-label publisher ownership.

Signed Binary Notice • Why Windows SmartScreen Still Prompts Temporarily

100% Cryptographically Signed (v0.5.0): Every official download—including the outer Universal Web & Offline Setup.exe launchers, inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, and all 5 C++20 executables (InstallerStudio.exe, instbuild.exe, SetupWizard.exe, msiprism.exe, and RaggieSoftHelp.exe)—is Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Verified publisher: Michael Ragsdale, RFC 3161 timestamped, and verified with signtool verify /pa).

Why SmartScreen may still say “Windows protected your PC” right now: Our Microsoft Public Trust signing certificate is brand-new (issued November 25, 2026). Under Microsoft’s current SmartScreen rules, newly issued certificates start at zero download reputation until initial install telemetry and Microsoft Security Intelligence (WDSI) review finish (already submitted). To install safely while reputation clears: click More info, confirm Windows shows Publisher: Michael Ragsdale (never “Unknown publisher”), and click Run anyway. Full details in the FAQ →

2 • Proposed RaggieSoft Studio IDE

RaggieSoft Launcher Studio — Custom Desktop App Hubs Without Gatekeepers

Indie software studios, narrative creators, audio labels, and internal enterprise tool teams often publish half a dozen desktop apps and content packs—yet building a polished, accessible desktop hub and patcher from scratch takes months. We built RaggieSoft Launcher for our own ecosystem; RaggieSoft Launcher Studio turns that architecture into a reusable visual IDE for everyone.

  • Visual Catalog & Branding Designer (.rslp Manifests): Organize app tiles, offline book/music shelves, release notes, hero banners, and Light/Dark/High-Contrast brand palettes with live WCAG 2.2 AA contrast verification.
  • Zero-Account, Static-CDN Catalog Updates: Publish a single static JSON catalog + signed .msi, .msp, or Engine = native packages on any HTTPS host or S3/R2 bucket—zero database servers, zero forced user logins, and zero telemetry.
  • Cryptographic Integrity Built In: Every background download verifies build-stamped SHA-256 digests and WinVerifyTrust Authenticode publisher signatures before execution.
3 • Proposed RaggieSoft Studio IDE

RaggieSoft Showcase Studio — Interactive Launchpads & Collector's Edition Menus

In the golden age of boxed PC software and CD-ROMs, inserting a disc greeted you with a custom illustrated menu complete with ambient audio, lore booklets, bonus tracks, and one-click install buttons. While physical optical drives are rarer today, commemorative USB box sets, downloadable ISO collector's editions, multi-package installer front-ends, offline press kits, and museum/classroom kiosks still benefit hugely from a self-contained interactive menu!

  • Drag-and-Drop Page & Hotspot Canvas (.rssp Projects): Design multi-page 16:9, 4:3 retro, or borderless desktop launchpads with custom artwork, hover/focus states, audio previews, RichEdit liner notes, and action buttons (launch Setup.exe, open local docs, browse folders, or switch pages).
  • Zero-Dependency Static /MT C++20 Runtime: Compiles down to a compact native x64 & ARM64 executable that boots instantly off a USB drive, mounted ISO, network share, or extracted archive with zero browser runtime bloat.
  • Modern Accessibility Under Classic Nostalgia: Unlike 1990s bitmap-only autorun menus that were invisible to screen readers and keyboards, every Showcase Studio button and hotspot exposes real Win32 Tab focus rings, Alt+Key mnemonics, UI Automation labels, and SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST support!
